tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The Sweep purple #39235F in light, the lavender #C4C0FF in dark (kept from 4.x). Filled buttons, links, active tab and navigation bar, focused field border, switches on, the keyboard focus ring (2 px with a 2 px gap: 12.7 : 1 light, 10.9 : 1 dark), the “Toolbox” of the wordmark. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Soft violet tint: FAB, selected chips, highlighted rows. Text on it: on-primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: From the Sweep pale purple #DED7EB (hue 296, the hue of the neutrals), tone 30 in light. Secondary icons and text accents; rarely a fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: The Sweep pale purple #DED7EB in light: tonal buttons, filter and selected chips, segmented selection, environment badges, avatars and the active navigation pill (with a 3 px primary bar, because the pill is 1.1 : 1 on the band). Text on it: on-secondary-container.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container (12.2 : 1 light, 7.3 : 1 dark).

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: From the Sweep lime #DCEAB4: olive in light (tone 30, 8.9 : 1 on the page), pale lime in dark. Running dots and deploy states, never a fill. The neon green stays in the logo only.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: The Sweep lime #DCEAB4 in both themes (pinned in dark): the Run action (Run, Deploy, Apply, New run; one per screen, a tonal button, never in a dialog), the disc behind the play icon of row Re-run actions, “Deploying…” chips. Text on it: on-tertiary-container.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Label and play icon on tertiary-container (the Run button, “Deploying…” chips): the Sweep purple #39235F in both themes (pinned), 10.4 : 1 on lime.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error role. Error outlines, ERR log level, destructive text buttons, error text. Light is tone 30 (#93000A, 8.9:1 on surface) so error text clears 7:1; dark stays tone 80.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: the page surface is near-neutral (chroma 4); the containers (dialogs, menus, pickers, panels) are a light purple one step lighter than MD3 (chroma 10, tones 97/96/94/92); the navigation is the deepest violet band (nav-container).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on any surface tone.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, captions, inactive icons. 8.9:1 on surface in light, 10.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: nav-container
tokens.usage: Navigation frame only: top app bar, rail, drawer, bottom navigation bar, bottom app bar — header and rail (or drawer) share it so they read as one frame. The deepest light surface: a violet band (night hue, chroma 20, tone 92 = #EDE4FF), darker than the pale containers; night tone 10 in dark. Active item and chips on it: nav-active.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default container: app bar, panels, list zebra.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, highest tonal step.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons and chips, text-field resting border.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Snackbar action text. Dark is tone 30 (#413C8A, 7.2:1 on the pale inverse surface).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow colour for the elevation tokens.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI-powered features, Material tones: deep teal in light (tone 30, 8.9 : 1), light teal in dark. AI marks drawn as lines or dots (working dots, pen orbit, guide track, sparkle icon). Fills use ai-container. Never chrome, navigation or non-AI buttons.

tokens.name: ai-container
tokens.usage: AI suggestion cards and AI chips.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy / passing (tone 30 in light). Status dots, INFO log level. Status is never told by colour alone: success chips carry the check glyph and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded / attention (tone 30 in light). WARN log level. Always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: logo-box
tokens.usage: Brand token (logo family, not a UI role): the toolbox box and handle of the mark, the favicon and app-icon tiles, the brand loader and the state marks. Night #0D0B14 on light backgrounds, lavender on dark.

tokens.name: on-logo-box
tokens.usage: Brand token: the > chevron of the prompt on logo-box.

tokens.name: logo-cursor
tokens.usage: Brand token: the cursor of the prompt on logo-box, full neon on the night box, emerald on the lavender box. The neon is used nowhere else.

tokens.name: logo-ai
tokens.usage: Brand token: the AI badge of the mark and the teal of the brand loader, the light teal #80D5D4 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-logo-ai
tokens.usage: Brand token: the “AI” letters on logo-ai.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Metadata: IDs, paths, timestamps, log levels (Open Sans, 600 for emphasis).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal output, keys, URLs, connection strings — Open Sans at 600 so data stands apart from prose.

spacing.note: 4 px grid. Component insets use 2–6; section rhythm uses 6–12.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, filled-button horizontal padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side gutters of long-form reading pages at Large and up (app pages use the layout-margin-* of their window class).

breakpoint.note: Material 3 window size classes. A breakpoint is the lower bound of a class (window width, px): compact < 600 ≤ medium < 840 ≤ expanded < 1200 ≤ large < 1600 ≤ extra-large. Shell follows the window; page content follows the page area (.ait-page container).

tokens.name: breakpoint-medium
tokens.usage: Medium: 600–839 px, tablets in portrait, foldables, narrow windows.

tokens.name: breakpoint-expanded
tokens.usage: Expanded: 840–1199 px, tablets in landscape, small laptops, half a desktop screen.

tokens.name: breakpoint-large
tokens.usage: Large: 1200–1599 px, laptops and desktops — the reference mockups are 1440 × 900.

layout.note: Page margins, grid columns and gutters per window class; content widths. CSS: --ait-page-margin, --ait-grid-columns, --ait-grid-gutter switch at the breakpoints.

tokens.name: layout-navigation-rail
tokens.usage: NavigationRail width: the default navigation from 600 px, Medium to Extra-large.

tokens.name: layout-navigation-drawer
tokens.usage: NavigationDrawer width, opened on demand from the rail menu: pushes the page from 1200 px, over the page below.

tokens.name: layout-assistant-width
tokens.usage: Docked assistant default width (320 – min(640 px, 50 %)), Large and up.

tokens.name: layout-page-min-with-assistant
tokens.usage: The page keeps at least this width beside the docked assistant; an open drawer folds back to the rail to make room.

tokens.name: layout-side-column
tokens.usage: Side column beside the table when the page area is ≥ 1040 px (400 px from 1380 px).

tokens.name: layout-reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a text column (docs, settings, policies).

tokens.name: layout-form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a single-column form.

tokens.name: layout-short-height
tokens.usage: Under this window height (phone in landscape): rail instead of bar, full-screen dialogs.

radius.note: Material 3 shape scale with a 16 px ceiling: Large is the largest corner on any rectangle; full is reserved for circles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The ceiling of the scale: buttons, segmented buttons, search bars, navigation items (hover and active), dialogs, sheets, pickers, large FAB, large panels. The logo box corner (10/64 of the mark).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Pinned to radius-lg — nothing in the system is rounder than 16 px except circles. Kept for Material naming (corner-extra-large).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: avatars, badges, radio, switch, icon-button state layers, dots. Never on buttons, pills, search bars or navigation items.

shadow.note: Tonal surface containers first; shadows only where the MD3 spec asks.

meta.scheme: Palettes from the three Sweep colours (v5.0, colour review option C): primary from the Sweep purple #39235F (hue 303), secondary from the pale purple #DED7EB (hue 296, the hue of the night neutrals), tertiary from the lime #DCEAB4 (hue 125); neutrals from #0D0B14 (hue 296). One tone rule: light roles at tone 30 (primary at 20, the Sweep purple itself), dark roles at 80, containers 90 / 30, text on containers 10 / 90. Kept from 4.x: the whole dark primary family on the lavender #C4C0FF (hue 288), the light primary-container #E3DFFF, the error family, the neutrals and nav-container. Pinned: tertiary-container is the lime in both themes (the Run button stays lime in dark) and on-tertiary-container is the Sweep purple #39235F in both themes (the Run label). Shape ceiling 16 px. History: v4.2–4.5 tuned the light surfaces, containers and the navigation band; v4.6 moved Run to the Sweep lime; v4.7 moved the light primary to #39235F. v5.0 removes run, on-run, run-icon, run-outline, run-text (Run = tertiary-container), nav-active (= secondary-container), focus-ring (= primary), ai-strong (= ai) and the legacy surface-variant; logo-box, on-logo-box, logo-cursor, logo-ai and on-logo-ai form the brand group (logo only).
meta.fonts: BNPP Type (UI: display, headline, title, label) as a file, weight 500; Open Sans (body, code and identifiers) from Google Fonts. No monospace face.
